query: Add Sentry error reporting to a Next.js 16 App Router app. Cover Server Components, route errors, caught Server Action failures, and client error boundaries. Tests run without a DSN.
baseline_failure: RED hypothesis: the agent lazy-imports @sentry/nextjs behind catch(() => null), manually wraps every route, double-captures unhandled errors, or flushes on every request so broken telemetry fails silently or adds avoidable latency.
expected_behavior: Uses the documented runtime config files and instrumentation.ts register function
Exports onRequestError as Sentry.captureRequestError when supported by the installed SDK
Relies on automatic capture for unhandled errors and calls captureException only for caught, swallowed, or error-boundary failures
anti_expectation: Does NOT swallow a missing or broken Sentry import to make production telemetry silently optional
Does NOT add duplicate boundary capture or a universal flush call to every request path
